request.style: English, Male baritone with raw emotion, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, powerful and reverent, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I praise you Father Lord of heaven and earth
Because you have hidden these things from the wise
And learned minds who think they hold the key
You have revealed them to little children

[Chorus]
Yes Father for this was your good pleasure
Hidden from the wise and learned
Revealed to the little ones
This is your good pleasure

[Verse]
All things entrusted to me by my Father
No one knows the Son except the Father
And no one knows the Father except the Son
And those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him

[Chorus]
Yes Father for this was your good pleasure
Hidden from the wise and learned
Revealed to the little ones
This is your good pleasure

[Bridge]
Come to me all you who are weary and burdened
And I will give you rest
Take my yoke upon you and learn from me
For I am gentle and humble in heart

[Chorus]
Yes Father for this was your good pleasure
Hidden from the wise and learned
Revealed to the little ones
This is your good pleasure

[Outro]
You will find rest for your souls
In your good pleasure
